_comment: The kinds no shape may write, and why — the platform's policy, reviewed in a pull request like the rest of the code. Patient-scoped kinds of R4 that are neither admitted (RECORD_RESOURCES) nor here are open to administrators' shapes (src/fhir/kinds.ts).
MedicationRequest: prescribing is an order with its own review; apps change the status of an existing prescription (medication.stop), never write one
MedicationAdministration: administering medication is a workflow with its own safeguards
ServiceRequest: an order sets other systems in motion; not a form
DeviceRequest: an order sets other systems in motion; not a form
NutritionOrder: an order sets other systems in motion; not a form
CommunicationRequest: a request for others to act; not a record of what happened
RequestGroup: a group of orders; not a form
VisionPrescription: a prescription with its own review
Appointment: scheduling is the appointment extension, not a record
Schedule: scheduling is the appointment extension, not a record
Slot: scheduling is the appointment extension, not a record
Patient: identity is the hospital information system's
Practitioner: identity is the hospital information system's
PractitionerRole: identity is the hospital information system's
Organization: identity is the hospital information system's
RelatedPerson: identity is the hospital information system's
Device: equipment is an inventory, not a clinical record
Coverage: insurance and billing are not clinical records
Account: insurance and billing are not clinical records
ChargeItem: insurance and billing are not clinical records
Claim: insurance and billing are not clinical records
ClaimResponse: insurance and billing are not clinical records
CoverageEligibilityRequest: insurance and billing are not clinical records
CoverageEligibilityResponse: insurance and billing are not clinical records
ExplanationOfBenefit: insurance and billing are not clinical records
Invoice: insurance and billing are not clinical records
RiskAssessment: a risk is a computed value; the platform computes nothing
GuidanceResponse: decision support; the platform recommends nothing
MeasureReport: a computed measure; the platform computes nothing
ImmunizationRecommendation: a recommendation; the platform recommends nothing
ImmunizationEvaluation: an evaluation against a schedule; the platform judges nothing
ImagingStudy: imaging comes from the PACS; apps show studies, never write them
Observation: measurements have their own section, record_observation, with codes, units and cross-component rules
Condition: diagnoses have their own section, record_problem
AllergyIntolerance: allergies have their own section, record_allergy
Procedure: procedures have their own section, record_procedure
Task: tasks have their own section, create_task
Media: photos have their own section, record_photo
QuestionnaireResponse: forms are designed with `form`, not written as records
Questionnaire: forms are designed with `form`, not written as records
Provenance: the platform writes the provenance of every record itself
AuditEvent: the platform writes its audit trail itself
